attachment2_file: 01_data/raw/E题数据/附件2-数据集特征文件/aligned_50.pkl
attachment3_directory: 01_data/raw/E题数据/附件3-模态缺失特征样本/对齐版本
attachment2_test_policy: labeled_holdout_for_one_time_final_evaluation_only; never train or tune on it
text_channel_evidence: token IDs integral and within 0..29824 in attachment 2; attention channel binary; segment channel zero; attachment 3 channels integral float32 with the same pattern
text_preprocessing: cast attachment3 text_bert float32 integral values to int64; use identical tokenizer vocabulary and text encoder weights for train/valid/inference; encoder choice remains a Task06 implementation decision
precomputed_text_policy: attachment2 text (50,768) is not available in attachment3 and must not be a required inference input
numeric_dtype_policy: convert audio/vision consistently to float32 inside downstream model pipeline; fit any scaling using train only
id_policy: attachment2 id is an audit key; attachment3 file stem is the submission/sample key and has no id field
intensity_target: signed raw regression_labels (or identical label.xlsx label), range [-3,3]; do not take absolute value
attachment2_zero_row_policy: original all-zero rows are not automatically missing; preserve original values and maintain an explicit artificial missing mask
attachment3_zero_row_policy: detect maximal contiguous all-zero feature rows per modality; retain boundary/padding ambiguity flags; internal zero runs bracketed by nonzero rows are high-confidence candidates
attachment3_text_missing_policy: text feature rows are absent; text_bert attention padding zeros are not local modality missingness; no text missingness observed by this audit

missing_simulation.input: unaltered attachment2 train or valid features
missing_simulation.audio_vision_action: set a consecutive interval X_modality[s:e,:] to 0 and M_modality[s:e] to 0; all other M positions remain 1
missing_simulation.text_action: mask consecutive actual token positions in text_bert: input_ids=0, attention_mask=0, token_type_ids=0 and explicit M_text=0; do not select special or padding tokens; use the selected fraction of eligible tokens rather than 50 positions; text token index is not physical audio/vision time
missing_simulation.train_missingness: random modality, start and length with fixed seed; include synchronized audio+vision
missing_simulation.validation_missingness: fixed deterministic modality x rate x position grid; compare on identical valid samples

leakage_policy: fit model and preprocessing on attachment2 train; select structure/hyperparameters/thresholds on valid; attachment2 test reserved; attachment3 never used for selection
